summary: Builder 1's step for M4 (L5's runner tier, slice 1 with Types and Rng, slice 2 with Params, Checks, D3 and the fingerprint re-bless) is finished and still green. This start was a restart after the 20:51 usage pause. The brief was the resume text from 19:53 and is out of date: on 18 Nov the guard was unified (20:06), the mutants were re-run under the SAFETY rules (20:10 to 20:16) and verify passed (20:23). After that, builder 2 built slices 3 and 4 on top. So I rebuilt nothing and re-checked everything. (1) Every file of my step is as I left it, apart from builder 2's planned additions: the family rows in Properties.spec, Tol.PROP_N_FAST, and the Definitions spec reading TS_PERFECT_CORE_MIN_MS from TimingStrike. (2) The recursion guard uses Test.SELFTEST_CHILD everywhere, and no BLACKSMITH_RUNNER_SELFTEST_CHILD is left. Every runner that Runner.spec spawns names a tools/runner-selftest root, the exit-2 cases included, and verify is spawned from tools/. The three guard cases (the spec, the holder root, verify) pass. (3) The 40 mutants were re-run on a new .git-free copy of the current worktree: 40 caught, none hung, no process left behind, and the copy equalled the worktree afterwards. (4) `--quick --filter "Minigames/"` gives 58 pass and 5 skip in 0.37 to 0.41 s by the runner. (5) `lune run scripts/verify -- --quick` in the worktree is green: 770 pass, 0 fail, 47 skip, 29.35 s by the runner at 5 to 26 % load (median 10). In docs/build/M4-notes.md, B1 gains a bullet for this re-check, and its open issues are updated: the slice 3 item is struck, PROP_N_FAST is now present, and a pointer to the SPEC edits for the Types fields is added. The handoff is unchanged. The lead's two Rojo serve processes on the main tree were left alone. No process of mine is running.

§6.3's % is written mod(x, m) = x − floor(x/m)·m (I6). The values are the same, and the handoff rewrites §6.3 and §6.4.

The brief cites §4.1's list, which has no round or clamp. The Minigames modules keep §6.4 rule 2, which lists round and clamp, because §6.5's round_q(clamp(…)) and the prototype parity (D1) need math.round itself: floor(x + 0.5) differs at 0.49999999999999994. Source.spec allows floor, ceil, round, abs, min, max, clamp, sqrt and huge.

T-RNG-01's vectors are E-S3.1's, not E-S8.5's kat/ (I1). T-RNG-03 and 05 follow the plan's reading (G12). T-RNG-06 takes lag-1 pairs non-overlapping and so has 32 cases, not the plan's 37 (critic B's run also had 5 overlapping pairs); its highest χ² is 28.20 either way.
Files beyond L1's list, all for L5 and the guard: tests/lib/Test.luau (t.volume, SELFTEST_CHILD, SELFTEST_SPEC), tools/runner-selftest/{volume, bless, nospec, holder}/, and tools/README.md's rows.

T-META-05's earlier cases changed for the guard. The argument faults now run on the pass root. `--root scripts` became the nospec root. `--root ../outside` became tools/runner-selftest/pass/../pass, which is the same `..` refusal. The working-directory case names runner-selftest/pass from tools/. The --bless probe runs the bless root instead of tests/Meta.

The runner's guard refuses any root whose specs include .../Meta/Runner.spec.luau, rather than the root `tests` by name. That makes the refusal testable on a small stand-in root, and it also covers tests/Meta and any parent.

Runner.spec sets its environment variables in its own process around each spawn (children inherit them, and they are restored after) instead of using process.spawn's env option, which costs about 85 ms per child.
